testcase.name: the sign-in screen stands in front of the app
a new workspace can be registered
the workspace can hold a profile and a finished run
original practice persists into a second signed-in browser session
signing out returns to the sign-in screen
signing in again finds the work still there
a session that dies mid-use returns to sign-in, not an error banner
versioned short practice and its accepted feedback survive a fresh signed-in session
opt-in dated material and own receipt persist through reload and a clean signed-in browser
own G1 comparison is explicit again in a clean signed-in browser and leaves saved learning intact
a shared route persists through a clean signed-in browser with one active budget and an exact lesson link
owned unsaved route input survives authenticated Legal but never syncs to a clean browser and clears after logout ACK
